body: Founder asked for a 'where do we stand' status update as a blog post. Published https://okemily.com/blog/red-garden-where-we-stand-territory-and-eleven-heroes/ covering the territory system and all 6 new heroes this session (Tree, Pizza, Flamel/Druid merge, Morrigan, Dagda, The Courier). Also fixed redgarden.html's stale roadmap section (still said heroes were 'queued, not yet wired into a match' -- replaced with a real VS2 entry reflecting the live 11-hero roster + territory system + persistent bot pool). Deployed via ~/okemily-deploy.sh. OKEMILY fc5de1f.
title: Blog: RED GARDEN status post + stale redgarden.html fix
